buildCommand:
curl -fsSL https://releases.rive.app/cli/install.sh | bash && export PATH="$HOME/.rive/bin:$PATH" && rive tools/rive/gretel --verify && rive tools/rive/gretel --once && mkdir -p dist && rive inspect tools/rive/gretel --json > dist/inspect.json && rive tools/rive/gretel --screenshot=dist/gretel.png --advance=1s && base64 -w0 tools/rive/gretel/build/gretel-2.riv > dist/gretel.riv.b64 && base64 -w0 dist/gretel.png > dist/gretel.png.b64 && printf 'Gretel Rive Build
ready
' > dist/index.html
